scope: Steps 1 and 2 only: local metadata inventory and concrete design; no production implementation, training, feature extraction, or HPC execution
supersedes_for_future_work: Provisional reference and module choices in runs/modern_head_comparison_design_20261015/onboarding_refinement.md; no historical contracts or results are changed
input_version: verified current-inclusive RECENT E3 plus existing q14 transform; OLD_BANK denotes reference UID identity, never permission to substitute old early-prefix features

head_integration.initial_anchor: QUERY_TAIL_R3, whose code is ready but real endpoint and results are pending
head_integration.same_module_definition: same geometry, bank construction, source-only scale and protection algorithm; head-specific logit scales and source-selected lambda
head_integration.paired_baseline: same frozen head weights, same source CAL cut, same seed or ensemble, same query UIDs and evaluation weights

OLD_BANK.interpretation: historical bank anchor; CIC and UNSW historical acquisition policies differ

unified_policy.t0_rule: published or recorded capture start fixed before outcomes, shared by devices in that capture, not first device error or favorable protocol
unified_policy.normal_source: publisher-declared normal archive, passive observation; no claim of logged active functional commissioning
unified_policy.component_identity: owner plus canonical bidirectional five-tuple, deduplicated across captures; not a statistical independence claim
unified_policy.representative: last legal target within the window per component; ascending timestamp/capture_id/frame/uid resolves ties
unified_policy.reference_end_rule: whole bank cutoff strictly before query timestamp; same-capture reference frame strictly before query frame
unified_policy.protocol_allocation: round-robin TCP then UDP, skipping exhausted lists, up to max_total_components
unified_policy.missing_material: explicit NOT_AVAILABLE or PREPARATION_REQUIRED, with all queries retained under head fallback; never pass missing attack evidence

B1.within_protocol_selection: round-robin nonempty strata in fixed lexicographic order; component hash within stratum
strata: verified normal reference activity or UNKNOWN
B1.unannotated_activity: ACTIVE_UNANNOTATED and absent/unverified operation labels map to UNKNOWN, never to invented functional stages

B2.within_protocol_selection: same algorithm as B1, with protocol quotas from B0-style allocation on the two-hour candidate universe
B2.role: bounded observation-duration comparison, no assumed improvement and no automatic extension

reference_experiments.identical_actual_banks: reuse matched outputs when actual reference UIDs and all scoring inputs are identical; report B0/B1 equivalence, never count it as independent evidence or select a different representative to force a contrast
reference_experiments.full_candidate_generation: later preparation must enumerate and validate legal endpoints in the fixed normal windows; sparse historical endpoint counts are lower bounds, not the complete candidate universe
reference_experiments.new_source_reference_policy: not introduced in v1; source FIT/CAL roles and original 104 dedicated references stay fixed; expanded source bank requires a separately versioned role/component plan

geometry.normalizer: verified parent source-FIT E3 normalizer, same fixed geometry for all candidate heads
geometry.q: unchanged 14-dimensional fixed transform from the reference or query's own causal snapshot
geometry.reference_q_adapter: separate validated reference entry point required; existing query descriptor rejects REFERENCE; no row-role forgery or zero filling
geometry.radius_scope: each protocol separately, original source FIT normal queries with two time-legal original own-reference components
geometry.radius_weights: recompute existing normal hierarchical weights within this protocol and eligible FIT-normal subset, normalize to one; do not alter evaluation weights
geometry.radius_statistic: second-smallest distinct-component distance per query, separately for dz and dq
geometry.quantile_rule: lowest observed value with cumulative normalized weight >= requested probability, no interpolation
geometry.zero_radius: zero distance maps to zero normalized distance; positive distance maps to unsupported, never divide by zero or enlarge radius
geometry.missing_source_protocol_pairs: disable module correction for that protocol, report NO_SOURCE_GEOMETRY_SUPPORT
geometry.invalid_reference_count: support=0 when fewer than two legal distinct components
geometry.engineering_error: zero-norm E3, nonfinite inputs, broken UID join, incorrect provenance: fail explicitly; not ordinary fallback

bounded_correction.scale_per_head_seed: weighted Q90-Q10 of all original source FIT logits, using original training weights with normal/attack mass 0.5 each
bounded_correction.scale_zero: disable correction for that seed without selecting an arbitrary replacement scale
bounded_correction.dtype: exactly convert original seed logits to float64 and compute correction in float64
bounded_correction.no_op: if support, lambda, or scale is zero, return original score exactly
bounded_correction.protected_score_band: original_logit-cut > lambda*scale implies alarm cannot be withdrawn; this is not a guarantee about labels
bounded_correction.ensemble: same ordered float64 mean of the three corrected logits, compared with the original ensemble cut; never Boolean voting
bounded_correction.TabM_internal: retain head plan's internal mean-probability then stable logit conversion before external seed aggregation

source_protection.CAL_attack_use: choose lambda after fixing head endpoints, geometry, and bank roster
source_protection.lambda_selection: largest candidate with zero newly missed originally head-detected source CAL attacks across every seed and final ensemble for every registered legal source bank
source_protection.bank_roster: all original source device/protocol banks from the 104 dedicated references, sorted by device then protocol; each query only checks bank.protocol == query.protocol, complete-bank cutoff < query timestamp, and >=2 distinct components
source_protection.bank_end: original complete-bank cutoff, never truncated subset cutoff to bypass time restrictions
source_protection.cross_device_donors: source-only worst-reference protection, not target reference collection
source_protection.roster_lock: actual reference UIDs, validity matrix and deterministic order pinned before target scoring
saturation_report: number of CAL attacks whose decisions each lambda could change
source_protection.new_target_bank_safety: not certified by original source-bank calibration; prospective target paired evaluation remains required

evaluation.full_query_set: retain original ordered UID sets, labels and weights for every policy, including early and unsupported queries
evaluation.early_queries: head-only until that policy's whole bank is available; no retroactive correction
evaluation.late_matched_subset: secondary report of original queries strictly after their own pool/capture t0+7200; never use a global absolute maximum across CIC and UNSW dates; freeze UID sets and weights before new scores, report lost early exposure separately
evaluation.secondary_subset_weights: original evaluation weights conditioned within each device/class and pool/class as explicitly reported, never substitute for full-query primary metrics
evaluation.same_component_history: earlier same-component continuation allowed under existing policy; report continuation and distinct-component queries separately
evaluation.source_roles: no FIT/CAL component or role reassignment to manufacture new source banks
evaluation.new_miss_gate: integer count(label=1 AND paired_head_alarm AND NOT full_alarm)==0, each seed and ensemble separately; no offset by other rescued attacks
evaluation.three_device_status: new-input cache and separate replay still required; first two-pool result cannot declare all-pool complete-system PASS
evaluation.protocol_guard: retain new-head versus same-seed/ensemble RECENT source CAL TCP/UDP/Hydra and nonempty CIC protocol recall maximum drop 0.001 at each original source-calibration rule
evaluation.OLD_LEVEL_PRESERVED: report only, not an extra acceptance threshold
evaluation.module_gain: report weighted FPR difference and relative reduction per pool/device; zero-op systems can meet absolute goals but cannot establish module benefit; no invented new 30% gain requirement
mechanism_controls: time/protocol/count-matched wrong-device bank where a predeclared donor exists
new_bank_coverage_reports: actual reference count and protocol components
query eligibility including raw and weighted normal/attack shares
evaluation.independent_confirmation: current A/B are development; still required after final method selection

future_preparation_required: validate current-input caches or restore under an explicitly identified input version
generate complete causal candidate metadata in the fixed normal windows and pin selected reference UIDs before scoring
produce real reference q14 with a dedicated role-safe adapter and matched RECENT E3
freeze source radius/scale/parameter receipts and source donor validity roster
engineering verification of causality, reference selection, no-op, correction bound, seed/ensemble arithmetic and per-UID acceptance
